description: Shared session vectors (payment-protocol.md 5, 6), generated by packages/device-sim. A device implementation set up with the values below must answer every step's `send` CBOR body with exactly the `expect` bodies (in order) and send the `phone` bodies to the phone app. `at` is the device clock (unix seconds) for that step. `powerCycle` is a RAM-clearing reset. `button` is the renter's answer to payment.prepare and setup.operator. A scenario with `initialState` UNPROVISIONED starts without key or setup values. A provisioned device was set up with PIN 2580; `pin` is what the renter enters whenever the device asks for the PIN, at setup or for a limit change (null: not entered in time). The device asks for the PIN before the approve button. The k-th random request (k = 0, 1, ...) returns bytes all equal to 0x5a + k: deviceNonce at each session.open (none for a refused one), then in a secure session the device's one-time key (32 bytes), and at setup the new key (32 bytes) and the nonce start (31 bytes, followed by a zero byte). Device signatures are deterministic (RFC 6979). Secure sessions (payment-protocol.md 4.1): the kiosk's one-time private key is 32 bytes of 0xe1 and its kioskNonce 32 bytes of 0xa5; `send` and `expect` are the bodies on the wire (AES-GCM after session.open.ok), and `plain` holds the CBOR bodies inside them. A scenario with `requireSecureSession` is a release device that refuses plaintext payment sessions. `requirePhone` with `phoneConnected` false is a release device with no bonded phone app listening; `linkBonded` false means every message comes from a central that is not bonded (payment-protocol.md 3); `devUnpairedAnchor` is the week-7 fixed setup's exception that lets a provisioned device take a setup session from such a central. Otherwise the phone app is connected and the link is bonded.

scenarios.description: anchor, two approved payments with sequential nonces, payment.outcome
no anchor: the device reports it and refuses with TIME_ANCHOR_MISSING
attestation not signed by the operator: MERCHANT_FORGED
order not signed by the attested merchant: MERCHANT_FORGED
payout differs from the attestation: MERCHANT_FORGED
expiry beyond authorizationExpiry: ATTESTATION_EXPIRED
attestation outside its validity plus anchorClockSkew: ATTESTATION_EXPIRED
the renter presses reject: USER_REJECTED, confirm.show still sent
session.confirm with another deviceNonce: NOT_PERMITTED
setup session while READY: NOT_PERMITTED
anchors not later than the last one or not signed by the operator are refused
a device-to-kiosk type sent to the device: UNSUPPORTED_TYPE
rental setup: setup.operator acked on the press, keygen ack with the new address after the PIN, anchor, then a payment from the new key starting at the nonce start
the renter refuses setup.operator: USER_REJECTED, the device stays UNPROVISIONED
the PIN is not entered in time: keygen TIMEOUT, nothing stored
setup.operator on a provisioned device or with a passkey over six digits: NOT_PERMITTED
device.reset: refused for another signer or device, accepted from the recorded operator in any session; the device ends UNPROVISIONED
limit change: confirm.limit to the phone, the PIN, the button, a signature with the next sequential nonce; a payment after it takes the following nonce
limit change with a wrong PIN: NOT_PERMITTED, nothing signed
limit change the renter rejects after the PIN: USER_REJECTED
pinMaxRetries wrong PINs lock the device: PIN_LOCKED for limit changes and payments, kept across a RAM-clearing reset
limit change for another contract: NOT_PERMITTED; expiry beyond authorizationExpiry: ATTESTATION_EXPIRED
requests outside the schema (a raw transaction, a Permit) in a payment session: UNSUPPORTED_TYPE with the zero session id, and the session is closed
secure session (4.1): the device proves the merchant's one-time key, answers with its own, and every later body both ways is AES-GCM; confirm.show to the phone stays plaintext
secure session.open refused with MERCHANT_FORGED: attestation not the operator's, one-time key not signed by the attested merchant, key not a curve point; no random draw is spent on a refusal
a secure body that fails the tag check: error{BAD_FRAME} under the channel and the session closes; the next sealed body meets no channel and is BAD_FRAME in plaintext
in a secure session payment.identify must attest the merchant session.open proved: another operator-signed merchant is MERCHANT_FORGED
release device: a plaintext payment session.open and a secure setup session.open are NOT_PERMITTED; setup stays plaintext and a secure payment session opens
an UNPROVISIONED device has no operator to check a secure session.open against: NOT_PERMITTED
release device with no phone app listening: payment.prepare and limit.change pass their checks, then are refused NOT_PERMITTED with nothing sent to a phone
a setup session.open from a central that is not bonded: NOT_PERMITTED; payment sessions need no bond
payment mode from the bonded phone app: on for 120 s and off are accepted, on for 0 s or over 300 s is NOT_PERMITTED; an open payment session is not touched
payment mode from a central that is not bonded, and on an UNPROVISIONED device: NOT_PERMITTED
week-7 fixed setup: the unpaired kiosk opens a setup session and hands over a TimeAnchor, but cannot record an operator; after device.reset the UNPROVISIONED device refuses the unpaired setup session
